notes: Copart is an online auction marketplace, not a traditional distributor; most distribution facets fit poorly.

durable_goods_distribution_specialty.value: Online auctions of used and salvage vehicles: cars, motorcycles, trucks, industrial and agricultural equipment

distribution_authorization.value: Operates as an auction marketplace connecting sellers and buyers, not as an authorized or independent product distributor

manufacturer_supplier_relationship.value: Vehicles consigned by sellers such as insurers; no manufacturer distribution agreement

aftermarket_sales_exposure.value: Used, salvage and wholesale vehicle resale; no new-equipment supply
